\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{فرصت} (fursat)}{فرصت (fursat)}]{\ur{فرصت} (fursat) — free time; leisure}

\label{lesson:UR-C513-fursat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for to water (plants), then the Urdu for to uproot.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{فرصت}}
\textbf{\ur{فرصت}} — \emph{fursat} — \textquotedblleft{}free time; leisure\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ur{آج} \ur{مجھے} \ur{بالکل} \ur{فرصت} \ur{نہیں} \ur{ہے۔}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āj mujhe bilkul fursat nahīṅ hai.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I have no free time at all today.
\end{quote}

Feminine.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{فرصت}} (\emph{fursat}) is usually traced, through Persian, to Arabic \emph{furṣa}, \textquotedblleft{}an occasion, a chance\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{fursat}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{fursat}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āj mujhe bilkul fursat nahīṅ hai.} — I have no free time at all today.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Urdu for to water (plants), then the Urdu for to uproot, then say \emph{fursat} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ur{فرصت} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Free time; leisure\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
